name: Snowman Logistics Ltd
title: Snowman Logistics Ltd - 538635 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Snowman's warehousing is running at 86–87% utilisation with price hikes sticking, but Q4 margins fell on start-up costs and West Asia disruption; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance beyond ~INR50 crore capex.

utilisation.quote: We were at around 86%, 87% for the last financial year.

capex.quote: Maybe around INR50 crores capex is the guideline for FY '27.

triggers.label: Price hikes passed through on renewals
triggers.quote: We have had a couple of price increases required this year and with Haryana changing the wage laws and all, that has been passed through and the customers have accepted that.

triggers.label: West Asia volumes subdued into April
triggers.quote: And April has also seen that trend actually. So, we're not sure when it will clear up.

triggers.label: INR1,000 cr revenue target slips
triggers.quote: Maybe it gets deferred by a year or so.

triggers.label: Capex guided down to ~INR50 cr
triggers.quote: Maybe around INR50 crores capex is the guideline for FY '27.

guidance.value: INR1,000 crore, with ~15% blended EBITDA margin (~INR150 crore EBITDA)
guidance.quote: INR1,000 crores is still our plan. Maybe it gets deferred by a year or so.
we would be trying to target a 15% growth for the rail segment. CFS is probably around 5%.
Maybe around INR50 crores capex is the guideline for FY '27.
rent payment would be around INR40 crores for the entire year.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin compression and cost overruns
red_flags.quote: So, it's not one clear cut answer that we have that this is what caused the lower EBITDA.

red_flags.label: Management evasive on market share and competition
red_flags.quote: we stopped giving individual region-wise market share. So, we won't be going ahead sharing that.

red_flags.label: Cash flow disclosure unclear under Ind AS leases
red_flags.quote: Maybe we'll come out with some system next quarter onwards.

evasions.quote: we keep hearing about the news, but I mean, there's nothing concrete which I can comment here about the competition.
we stopped giving individual region-wise market share. So, we won't be going ahead sharing that.
we can't give a proper guidance without evaluating what the situation, especially with this West Asia situation goes like.
